'''Power turrets''' were a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] weaponry. The ''[[Kragg's Fury]]'' was armed with power turrets, along with [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile tubes]].
